peoples_entry.name: Khaayken
peoples_entry.note: The Yeti Kingdom (Khaay Qantir / High-Kin) of Qoold Lheek (Cold Lake, +5,680–6,030 m) and Leng (+4,485 m): broad 1.15x arctic hominids covered in shaggy frost-white/taupe/slate fur (`coat: 'pelt'`), trading spun muskox `qiviut`, carved horn spoons, and soapstone oil-lamps, building pycrete domes, and wearing bog-iron/larch/antler lamellar alongside captured Eternian bronze war-trophies (LORE.md §3.1, §6.19; kits/yeti/PLAN.md).
